en.pit.departure.alias_alive: Alias thanks the party and leaves. The scent of honeysuckle fills the air as Dragonbait bows and follows her.
en.pit.departure.alias_dead: Dragonbait carries Alias's body toward Hillsfar.
en.zhentil.patrol_pass: A Zhentil Keep patrol notices the sigils on the party's arms and lets them pass.
en.zhentil.edge: You are at the edge of Zhentil Keep. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.zhentil.guards_question: The guards take the party aside for questioning and record Journal Entry 32.
en.zhentil.guards_warning: A guard says the party matches the little thief's description; the commander says they will get theirs inside.
en.zhentil.inner_city: You join the teeming masses of the inner city.
en.journal.32: Journal Entry 32: Two guards and their commander compile a detailed file on the party and insist that it is strictly routine.
en.zhentil.olive_appears: A female halfling appears from a hidden niche. You enter her statement as Journal Entry 50.
en.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: You enter the Dark Shrine through a hole in the wall made by the halfling's magical device. The walls close behind you as the device smokes and disappears.
en.zhentil.olive_explains: As Olive leads you through the dungeon, she explains about Dimswart the Sage. You record Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_door: Dimswart is just beyond this door.
en.journal.50.1: Journal Entry 50 (1/2): Olive says, “Well now, aren't we a fine bunch of adventurers. My name is Olive Ruskettle, and I know a bit about those tattoos on your arms. A friend of mine had similar marks a while back. I wonder where she is...”
en.journal.50.2: Journal Entry 50 (2/2): “Listen, you must get hold of the Amulet of Lathander. A man who can help you has been captured inside the temple. His name is Dimswart the Sage, and he helped that friend I mentioned. I know a secret way into the temple. What do you say?”
en.journal.51.1: Journal Entry 51 (1/2): “The human you seek is Dimswart. He is a very good sage and a music lover, which is why we get along. Did you know I was a bard? Yes sir, my harp is right here and I could sing for you—well, perhaps now is not the time.”
en.journal.51.2: Journal Entry 51 (2/2): “Anyway, Fzoul Chembryl captured Dimswart to learn about the other bonds. I can get you to his cell, but I need your help to free him. I'll slip out my own way; I cannot let any Banite priests see me. Only someone as slippery as I am can squeeze through the route I know.”
en.zhentil.olive_cell_hint: Olive suddenly appears and says that the man she mentioned is in the cell to the south.
en.zhentil.olive_repeats_dimswart: As Olive explains about Dimswart, you record her remarks as Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_appears: An old man is in the cell. He introduces himself, and you record his remarks as Journal Entry 12.
en.journal.12.1: Journal Entry 12 (1/6): Dimswart says, “My name is Dimswart the Sage. I am happy to meet you, though I wish it were under better circumstances. I knew others with bonds like yours and have studied them. Some symbols are now missing, but originally there must have been five—the power signs of five mighty factions joined together.”
en.journal.12.2: Journal Entry 12 (2/6): “Needless to say, all five are extremely evil. Their common purpose is to increase their collective power. Yet if this bonding follows the previous pattern—and with Moander and the Fire Knives involved I have little doubt—each evil power has its own use for you, at the others' expense. That is your greatest advantage.”
en.journal.12.3: Journal Entry 12 (3/6): “I know one bond personally. The hand with a mouth is Moander's symbol. His aspect was destroyed the last time he tried to enter this plane. Mogion, his surviving High Priestess, probably placed it upon you as part of her attempt to bring him back.”
en.journal.12.4: Journal Entry 12 (4/6): “The ornate Z inside a circle on a triangular field is the Zhentrim's mark—our hosts, I fear. They are said to hide a great hoard of lawful-good weapons and magic. I learned it is not in Zhentil Keep. Fzoul Chembryl seeks to place good people under his power so he can use these devices.”
en.journal.12.5: Journal Entry 12 (5/6): “The half moon crossed by three bars belongs to Dracandros, a powerful but banished Red Wizard of Thay obsessed with dragons. The flaming claws belong to Tyranthraxus. He is the greatest threat: he seeks dominion over the entire Prime Material Plane and controls the Pool of Radiance.”
en.journal.12.6: Journal Entry 12 (6/6): “To finish Tyranthraxus you need three artifacts divided among the powers that bonded you: the Amulet of Lathander here in Zhentil Keep, Dracandros's Helm of Dragons near Haptooth, and Mogion's Gauntlet of Moander at Yulash. I cannot offer much fighting power, but I know how to stay out of the way.”
en.zhentil.hooded_offer: A hooded woman suddenly appears. “Follow me. I can get you out of here! You are trapped here! My master can help you.”
en.zhentil.fzoul_interrupts: A strange shimmer surrounds you and the room begins to fade. A band of clerics bursts in, led by Fzoul Chembryl. He shouts, “Woman, you go too far!”
en.zhentil.fzoul_retreats: As the room fades away, Fzoul turns and rushes out.
en.dexam.arrival: You are led along a dark corridor and see Dexam the beholder. The hooded woman walks toward a milling group of armored minotaurs; they immediately snap to attention.
en.dexam.journal_30: Dexam speaks. You record his speech as Journal Entry 30.
en.dexam.amulet_choice: Dimswart the Sage whispers, “Look on the altar. That is the Amulet of Lathander.” What do you do?
en.dexam.fzoul_journal_7: Before you can act, an impressive man backed by troops, priests and mages rushes in. His statement is recorded as Journal Entry 7.
en.dexam.kills_fzoul: Dexam roars, “Then die, heretic!” and blasts Fzoul into a heap of ash. The bonds on your arms begin to writhe.
en.dexam.kill_order: “Now that the bond is gone, they are of no use to me. Kill them.”
en.dexam.amulet_rises: Dexam turns toward the altar and starts to leave. You notice the amulet rising to meet him.
en.dexam.altar_melee: As Dexam leaves, his forces and Fzoul's remaining troops begin to melee around you.
en.dexam.final_reveal: You have caught up with Dexam and his minions. The hooded woman casts off her disguise—she is a medusa!
en.dexam.amulet_retrieved: You retrieve the Amulet of Lathander from Dexam's mangled remains.
en.dexam.zhentil_attack: Forces of Zhentil Keep attack you!
en.dexam.departure.olive: Olive Ruskettle appears just outside the door. She says, “So, you made it. I'm surprised.”
en.dexam.departure.dimswart: “Dimswart, you come with me. A man from Shadowdale has some questions for you.” Olive and Dimswart leave.
en.dexam.departure.gharri: You see a rider in the distance. He stops suddenly, and a moment later you hear something like “Gharriiii” drifting through the air.
en.dexam.departure.riders: The rider changes direction and gallops to a woman dressed in purple. They embrace; she climbs onto the horse, and they ride away.
en.world.shadowdale.edge: You are at the edge of Shadowdale. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.journal.30.1: Journal Entry 30 (1/2): Dexam says, “So, these are Fzoul's little secret. Very interesting. As the representative of the TRUE priests of Bane, I shall deliver you to Mulmaster and the grand Imperceptor.”
en.journal.30.2: Journal Entry 30 (2/2): “In Mulmaster I will examine these bonds in my laboratory—to your extreme discomfort. During the final procedure, the one resulting in your death, the pain should last no more than two or perhaps three weeks. Once I uncover their secret, the Imperceptor will be most angry with dear little Fzoul, and we may finally be rid of this heretic and his precious mages.”
en.journal.7.1: Journal Entry 7 (1/2): “I am Fzoul Chembryl, high lord of the Dark Shrine. My precious mages, as you call them, allowed me to follow your minion. Dexam, you overstep your authority. My mark is on these people, and the Imperceptor will know of my work in due time.”
en.journal.7.2: Journal Entry 7 (2/2): “I work for the greater glory of Bane. The powers Bane granted us, joined with secular magic-users, will establish a Banite hegemony in the Realms. These bonded tools are central to our power and will let me control and evade the traps of lawful and good magic. They are under my authority and shall remain so for as long as I live.”

zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_alive: 愛麗雅絲說：「我們必須在此分別了。」她感謝你們一路相助，祝眾人好運後轉身離去。空氣中瀰漫著忍冬花香；龍餌靜靜看過每一位夥伴，鞠躬致意，隨後跟上愛麗雅絲。
zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_dead: 龍餌抱起愛麗雅絲的遺體，向眾人沉默地鞠躬，隨後朝希爾斯法的方向離去。
zh-TW.zhentil.patrol_pass: 一隊散提爾堡巡邏兵攔住你們。他們注意到眾人手臂上的枷印後，隨即放行。
zh-TW.zhentil.edge: 你們來到散提爾堡城外。要進城，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_question: 「站住！到這裡來！我們有些問題要問你們！」衛兵把隊伍帶到一旁盤問；你們將此事記入冒險手札第 32 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_warning: 離開時，你們聽見一名衛兵說：「果然和那個小賊說的一樣。」指揮官回答：「別擔心，他們進城後自然會吃到苦頭。」
zh-TW.zhentil.inner_city: 你們匯入熙來攘往的人群，進入散提爾堡內城。
zh-TW.journal.32: 手札條目 32：兩名衛兵與指揮官盤問你們。每回答一次「是」，其中一名衛兵便冷笑著記入冊中；每回答一次「否」，另一名衛兵便哼聲記在不同的簿冊。指揮官詳細抄下全隊的姓名、來歷與各項資料。每當有人追問盤查的理由，三人便一同冷笑；指揮官只說：「我們正在建立你們的檔案，這只是例行公事。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_appears: 一名半身人女子從隱密壁龕中現身。你們將她的話記入冒險手札第 50 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: 半身人帶著的魔法裝置在牆上開出洞口，你們就此穿牆進入幽暗神殿。身後牆壁重新閉合；裝置冒出白煙，隨即消失無蹤。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_explains: 奧莉芙領著你們穿過地牢，一路說明賢者迪姆斯沃特的遭遇。你們將此事記入冒險手札第 51 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_door: 迪姆斯沃特就在這扇門的另一頭。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_leaves: 奧莉芙微微一笑，轉眼便消失了。
zh-TW.journal.50.1: 手札條目 50（1/2）：奧莉芙說：「唷，這可真是一群了不起的冒險者。我叫奧莉芙・魯斯克特爾；你們手臂上的刺青，我倒知道一點。前陣子我有個朋友也帶著相似的印記。不曉得她如今人在何方……」
zh-TW.journal.50.2: 手札條目 50（2/2）：「聽著，你們一定得拿到洛山達護符。有個人能幫忙，可是他被抓進神殿囚禁了。他叫賢者迪姆斯沃特，也曾幫過我剛才提到的那位朋友。我知道一條進神殿的密道。你們意下如何？」
zh-TW.journal.51.1: 手札條目 51（1/2）：「你們要找的人類名叫迪姆斯沃特。他是位非常出色的賢者，而且熱愛音樂，所以我們才這麼投緣。你們知道我是吟遊詩人嗎？真的，我的豎琴就在身邊，本來還能唱一曲給你們聽——唔，現在或許不是時候。」
zh-TW.journal.51.2: 手札條目 51（2/2）：「總之，弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾抓走迪姆斯沃特，是為了逼問其他枷印的事。我能帶你們到牢房，但救他出來得靠你們。我會用自己的辦法溜走，絕不能讓貝恩祭司看見我。那條路狹窄得很，只有像我這般滑溜的人才鑽得過去。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_cell_hint: 奧莉芙忽然出現在你們面前。「總算來了。我提過的那個人，就關在南邊的牢房裡。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_repeats_dimswart: 奧莉芙說明迪姆斯沃特的遭遇；你們將她的話記入冒險手札第 51 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_appears: 牢房裡有一位老人。他自我介紹後，你們將他的話記入冒險手札第 12 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_join: 要讓迪姆斯沃特同行嗎？
zh-TW.journal.12.1: 手札條目 12（1/6）：迪姆斯沃特說：「我叫賢者迪姆斯沃特。很高興認識諸位，只可惜相逢的情勢不太理想。我曾遇過帶著相似枷印的人，也花了一段時間研究。你們身上有些符號已經消失，但原本應有五個——那是五個強大勢力聯手留下的力量印記。」
zh-TW.journal.12.2: 手札條目 12（2/6）：「不消說，這五方全都邪惡至極；他們結盟，是為了擴張共同的力量。然而，若這批枷印仍遵循過去的模式——既然牽涉摩安德與火焰匕首，我幾乎可以肯定——每一方都想利用你們達成自己的目的，甚至不惜損害其他盟友。這正是你們最大的優勢。」
zh-TW.journal.12.3: 手札條目 12（3/6）：「其中一道枷印，我有親身了解。掌心生口的手掌是摩安德的標誌。祂上次企圖進入這個位面時，化身已遭摧毀。如今很可能是祂倖存的大祭司摩貢把印記放在你們身上，作為讓摩安德重返世間的計畫之一。」
zh-TW.journal.12.4: 手札條目 12（4/6）：「三角形底紋、圓圈裡的華麗 Z 字，代表散塔林會——也就是我們眼下的『東道主』。據說他們藏有大批守序善良陣營的武器與魔法物品。我被捕前正追查此事，已確定寶藏不在散塔林堡。傳聞首領弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾企圖控制善良之人，好讓自己能夠運用那些寶物。」
zh-TW.journal.12.5: 手札條目 12（5/6）：「三道橫槓穿過半月，是德拉坎德羅斯的標誌。他是力量強大的塞爾紅袍法師，卻因野心過盛又不懂時機與手腕而遭放逐，並且對龍異常著迷。燃燒的利爪則屬於烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯；他的威脅最大，野心是支配整個主物質位面，而且掌握著光芒之池。」
zh-TW.journal.12.6: 手札條目 12（6/6）：「要徹底消滅提朗瑟克斯，你們需要三件分散在枷印勢力手中的神器：散塔林堡某處的洛山達護符、哈普附近德拉坎德羅斯持有的龍之頭盔，以及尤拉什摩貢掌控的摩安德護手。至於戰力，我恐怕幫不上太多；不過我也曾冒險，知道如何不礙你們的手腳。」
zh-TW.zhentil.hooded_offer: 一名兜帽女子忽然現身。「跟我來，我能帶你們離開！你們已被困在這裡；我的主人能幫助你們。」
zh-TW.zhentil.fzoul_interrupts: 奇異的微光籠罩眾人，房間開始淡去。就在消失前一刻，一群祭司闖入房內，領頭的是弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾。他怒喝：「女人，你太過分了！」
zh-TW.zhentil.fzoul_retreats: 房間逐漸淡去；弗佐爾轉身衝出房間。
zh-TW.dexam.arrival: 你們被領過一條幽暗長廊，眼前赫然是眼魔德克薩姆！兜帽女子走向一群來回走動的披甲牛頭人；牠們立刻挺身肅立。
zh-TW.dexam.journal_30: 德克薩姆開口說話；你們將他的演說記入冒險手札第 30 條。
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_choice: 賢者迪姆斯沃特低聲說：「看祭壇上，那就是洛山達護符。」你們要怎麼做？
zh-TW.dexam.fzoul_journal_7: 你們還來不及行動，一名氣勢逼人的男子便率領士兵、祭司與法師衝入房內。他的發言已記入冒險手札第 7 條。
zh-TW.dexam.kills_fzoul: 德克薩姆咆哮：「那就去死吧，異端！」接著把弗佐爾轟成一堆灰燼。你們感到手臂上的枷印開始扭動。
zh-TW.dexam.kill_order: 「枷印既已消失，他們對我再無用處。殺了他們。」
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_rises: 德克薩姆轉向祭壇，準備離去。你們注意到護符正飄向他。
zh-TW.dexam.altar_melee: 德克薩姆離開時，他的部隊與弗佐爾殘存的人馬在你們四周陷入混戰。
zh-TW.dexam.final_reveal: 你們追上德克薩姆與他的爪牙；兜帽女子卸下偽裝——她竟是一名梅杜莎！
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_retrieved: 你們從德克薩姆殘破的遺骸中取回洛山達護符。
zh-TW.dexam.zhentil_attack: 散提爾堡的部隊向你們發動攻擊！
zh-TW.dexam.departure.olive: 奧莉芙・魯斯克特爾出現在門外。她說：「你們居然成功了，真令我意外。」
zh-TW.dexam.departure.dimswart: 「迪姆斯沃特，跟我來。暗影谷有個人想問你幾個問題。」奧莉芙與迪姆斯沃特隨即離去。
zh-TW.dexam.departure.gharri: 你們看見遠處有一名騎士。他忽然停下；片刻後，一聲彷彿「嘉莉——」的呼喊隨風傳來。
zh-TW.dexam.departure.riders: 騎士改變方向，策馬奔向一名身穿紫衣的女子。兩人相擁；女子躍上馬背，隨後一同遠去。
zh-TW.world.shadowdale.edge: 你們來到暗影谷外。要進城，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.journal.30.1: 手札條目 30（1/2）：德克薩姆說：「原來這就是弗佐爾藏著的小祕密。有意思。身為貝恩正統祭司的代表，我要把你們送到穆爾馬斯特，交給總督察長。」
zh-TW.journal.30.2: 手札條目 30（2/2）：「到了穆爾馬斯特，我會在實驗室研究這些枷印——只怕你們會非常不舒服。最後一道程序將奪走你們的性命；放心，痛苦頂多持續兩三個星期。等我揭開枷印的祕密，總督察長必會對他親愛的小弗佐爾大發雷霆，我們也終於能除掉這名異端和他珍愛的法師。」
zh-TW.journal.7.1: 手札條目 7（1/2）：「我是弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾，幽暗神殿的最高領主。你口中那些『寶貝法師』讓我得以追蹤你的手下。德克薩姆，你已越權。這些人身上有我的印記；到了適當時候，總督察長自然會知道我的功績。」
zh-TW.journal.7.2: 手札條目 7（2/2）：「真正為貝恩至高榮耀效力的人是我。貝恩賜予我們的力量，加上世俗法師的魔法，將在諸國建立貝恩霸權；這些受枷印控制的工具正是鞏固權力的核心，也能讓我駕馭並避開善良與守序者藏在魔法物品裡的陷阱。他們受我支配，而且只要我還活著，就永遠如此。」
